Package com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport

Class TestPki

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport.TestPki
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class TestPki extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A small public key infrastructure generated at run time for the tests of TLS client authentication: a certificate authority, and server and client certificates it signs, each kept in a PKCS#12 key store inside one temporary directory that close() deletes. It drives keytool (see Keytool); nothing is ever kept in the repository.
